title: Ensemble Fidelity Gatekeeper: automated FP8/INT8 accuracy validator
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a lightweight, automated validator that acts as a gate for shipping new quantization profiles (FP8 and INT8). The Gatekeeper runs an ensemble of curated 'golden' prompts across calibration variants and quant profiles, computes multi-faceted fidelity metrics, and emits a deterministic pass/fail decision plus a human-readable regression report. Goals: (1) catch regressions introduced by calibration changes or new kernel selection; (2) provide per-profile signal (token-level, embedding, instruction-following) to guide rollouts and canary policies; (3) integrate with CI and the Redwood Console so new model/quant PRs fail fast when quality drops below established thresholds.
updates: 2025-02-18 - Ticket created by Ava Chen: initial proposal and scope. Linked Confluence draft for validator design.

2025-02-20 - Tech spike completed: compared three metric families (token-level logprob delta, embedding cosine similarity on reference answers, instruction-following rubric using a small LLM evaluator). Embedding cosine + logprob delta chosen as primary signals.

2025-02-24 - Design review with PM & Research: decided on stratified golden prompt ensemble covering short/long context, instruction style, and safety-sensitive queries. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/Ensemble+Fidelity+Gatekeeper

2025-02-27 - Prototype runner implemented in runtime/tests/quant_validator. Hooked into GitHub Actions for per-PR smoke runs (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8392). Initial runs on FP8 candidate profiles show mean embedding cosine 0.981 vs baseline float16 for non-adversarial set.

2025-03-01 - Calibration workflow: added calibration-replay mode to re-run calibration checkpoints against the golden set to produce deterministic KV cache states. This uncovered a calibration ordering bug in libkernels; created ENG-65590 to track fix.

2025-03-03 - Gate logic spec finalized: pass criteria = mean embedding cosine >= 0.975 AND p95 token logprob delta <= 0.12 AND instruction-following pass-rate >= 92%. Use Holm-Bonferroni correction for multiple prompt families. Thresholds recorded in runtime-1.22 release notes.

2025-03-04 - Instrumentation added: telemetry events emitted to Console dashboard 'quant-fidelity' and alert rules wired to #infra-quant Slack. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/quant-fidelity. Added unit tests for metric calculation and significance testing.

Open items: (1) finalize golden prompt ownership (design to curate safety-sensitive set), (2) add adversarial perturbation suite for continuous runs, (3) expose per-profile diagnostics in PR comment summarizer.
Next steps: integrate with Dedicated release pipeline, add historical drift detector that triggers a manual review when gradual degradation detected over 30 days.
notes: We must keep the golden set small enough for CI (<300 prompts) but broad enough to surface common regressions. Proposed initial size: 180 prompts across 6 families.
Decided against full BLEU-style metrics; they are brittle for open-ended outputs. Focus on embedding similarity and calibrated logprob deltas plus instruction-following checks.
Consider tagging each prompt with sensitivity and required gating weight so safety-sensitive prompts can veto even if other metrics pass.
PR checklist: (a) add validator smoke run, (b) add metric thresholds to release config, (c) add Dashboard tile, (d) add Slack alert rule.
